summary_en: Life Corporation completed a tender offer for Albis Co. at 3,780 yen per share, acquiring 6,045,556 shares (72.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock and non-tendering shareholders) during the 40-business-day period ending November 10, 2026. Albis will become a consolidated subsidiary on November 17, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Albis Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 7475) and Change in Subsidiary Status
translation_en_brief: Life Corporation, a Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime-listed supermarket operator, completed a tender offer for Albis Co., Ltd., also listed on Prime Market, acquiring 6,045,556 shares at 3,780 yen per share. The tender offer period ran from September 9, 2026, to November 10, 2026 (40 business days). The acquired shares represent 72.4% of outstanding shares calculated from 8,355,309 shares (total issued shares of 9,255,926 as of June 30, 2026, less treasury stock of 900,617 and excluding 1,388,440 shares held by non-tendering shareholder Mitsubishi Corporation and 100 shares already held by Life Corporation, as well as 10,575 restricted shares awarded to directors and executive officers). The minimum tender condition of 4,171,200 shares was satisfied with 6,045,556 shares tendered. As a result of successful completion, Albis will become a consolidated subsidiary of Life Corporation effective November 17, 2026 (settlement date). The transaction represents Life Corporation's strategic move to expand its retail operations through acquisition of another major supermarket chain.
